intro.label: About Us
intro.title:
Born from the territory.
Operating with purpose.
intro.body: Portugal NTN spent 12 years building and structuring walking trails across northern and northeastern Portugal. Now we operate them. Every programme we offer is a programme we designed, certified, and know by heart.
intro.body2: Every programme we sell was designed, waymarked and certified by us. We do not resell other people's routes: the team that welcomes you in Portugal is the same one that mapped the trail.

whyus.label: The NTN difference
whyus.title: Why walk with us
whyus.value1Desc: We adapt every programme to the group's needs.
whyus.value2Desc: Our team coordinates the full travel logistics.
whyus.value3Desc: Committed to the people and the territory.
whyus.value4Desc: We know every trail because we built them.
whyus.value5Desc: Genuine products from the communities we serve.
whyus.value6Desc: We operate locally to maximise the experience.

destinations.label: Where We Operate
destinations.title:
Where we walk,
we are local.
destinations.body: We operate in the regions we know best, from the Douro to the mountains of Trás-os-Montes, from Gerês to the inland Way of Saint James. Every destination is territory where we have roots.

sustainability.label: Our Commitment
sustainability.title:
Walking that
gives back
sustainability.body: Every step supports local communities, preserves cultural heritage, and funds the maintenance of the trails we helped create. Sustainability is not a tag. It is our origin story.

contact.title: Let's design your walk.
contact.body: Tell us your dates, how many you are and the pace you are looking for. We reply within 24 hours with a tailored proposal, written by the people who know the ground.

sustainablePage.heroTitle:
Walking leaves
a mark. Ours is
a positive one.
sustainablePage.heroBody: We operate nature tourism with a real commitment: every programme contributes to preserving the territories, developing local communities and valuing heritage.
sustainablePage.p1Body: Visiting is not enough. We believe in tourism that gives back more than it takes. That is why we built routes that respect nature's pace, support the local economy and preserve the memory of places.
sustainablePage.area1Body: Trails designed to minimise environmental impact and protect the biodiversity of the regions where we operate.
sustainablePage.area2Body: Every journey generates value for the accommodations, restaurants and producers of the communities we cross.
sustainablePage.area3Body: We work with local guides, hosts and partners, keeping the traditions and knowledge of the territory alive.
sustainablePage.area4Body: We value villages, ancient paths and cultural legacy, interpreting them for those who visit us.
sustainablePage.ctaBody: Talk to our team and discover how we craft responsible, memorable walking experiences.
sustainablePage.natureTitle: Trails that protect what they show
sustainablePage.natureBody: We walk in small groups, on marked and certified paths, at the pace of the land. The landscape is the reason people come, so keeping it intact is part of the job.
sustainablePage.economyTitle: Every walk pays the people who live here
sustainablePage.economyBody: Sustainability goes beyond nature. A territory only stays alive if people can make a living from it. That is why each programme is built with local businesses, and the value of the trip stays where the trip happens.
sustainablePage.whereLabel: Where the value of a walk goes

aboutPage.heroTitle:
Walking specialists
who know the ground
beneath your feet
aboutPage.heroSubtitle: Portugal NTN is a tourism and travel company offering distinctive experiences in safe yet challenging environments, where people and places take the leading role.
aboutPage.companyTitle: Genuine Portugal, at a human pace
aboutPage.companyBody1: We design small-group and tailor-made programs around adventure, culture and gastronomy, built on privileged contact with the most genuine side of Portugal, in harmony with local communities and a sustainable approach to the territory.
aboutPage.companyBody2: Our structured walking programs run from 1 to 15 days, in guided and self-guided formats, across the North and Northeast of Portugal.
aboutPage.teamBody1: Our team brings together people with military training and operational experience across several countries. Our guides are certified by the National School of Mountaineering in hiking, rope work and hiking instruction.
aboutPage.teamBody2: Safety, customer satisfaction and the commitment of our people are at the heart of how we work.
aboutPage.conductTitle: How we walk, and why it matters
aboutPage.conduct1Body: We work in partnership with local people and non-profit organisations, supporting local economies and keeping every program in tune with local traditions and culture.
aboutPage.conduct2Body: We promote the territory in a sustainable way, with social and environmental responsibility, preserving the natural and cultural heritage that makes each route unique.
aboutPage.conduct3Body: Safety guides every decision. We assess conditions on the ground, follow strict standards and keep improving based on our guests' feedback.
aboutPage.ctaBody: Explore our programmes or learn how we operate, sustainably and with purpose.
aboutPage.consultingTitle:
We built the territory.
Now we operate it.
aboutPage.consultingBody: Before creating any walking program, Portugal NTN spent 12 years structuring, signing and certifying pedestrian trails, Cyclin' Portugal Centres and Trail Running Centres across northern and northeastern Portugal. That fieldwork is at the root of every Walking program we offer.

gradingPage.intro: Every programme carries a difficulty grade so you know what to expect before you set off. The scale runs from very easy to very difficult, based on distance, elevation gain and terrain.

gate.title: The trails we create, open to the world.
gate.bracket: Northern Portugal on foot, at the pace of those who live there
gate.imageAlt: The Douro Valley, vineyard terraces above the river
gate.lead: We are local. We design, waymark and operate our own routes across the North and Northeast of Portugal.
gate.purpose: We walk with guides from the region, stay in the homes of those who live there and sit at the tables of local producers. The tourism we do has to leave the land better than we found it. Today we put that work at the service of operators worldwide, so their clients discover the North by walking it and living it from the inside.

hero.title: Northern Portugal, in the hands of those who drew its trails
hero.lead: Private walking journeys, for a day or for many, for operators whose clients look for the rare: the access, the table and the people only a local knows.

manifesto.statement: We did not come to this land to sell it. <accent>We belong to it.</accent>
manifesto.p1: We were born here, among terraced vineyards, granite villages and schist plateaus. Before welcoming our first traveller, we spent twelve years planning, waymarking and certifying the walking trails of Northern and North-Eastern Portugal, alongside the municipalities and communities who live them.
manifesto.p2: That work is what brought us to tourism. We know every trail because we drew it, every producer because they are our neighbour, every story because we heard it from those who lived it. Few guides hold that knowledge, and it is what we put at your client's service.
manifesto.caption: Our team waymarking a trail
manifesto.altA: A hand painting a trail waymark on a rock
manifesto.altB: Dirt path between vineyards in the Douro

sentir.title: Feel the place
sentir.text: Walking slowly, at the pace of the landscape, with time for silence, light and the scent of the land.

viver.title: Live the place
viver.text: Sitting at family tables, stepping into cellars and olive mills, learning a craft from those who keep it alive.

colaborar.title: Give back to the place
colaborar.text: Every journey leaves value behind: we buy local, hire local and care for the paths we walk. That, to us, is sustainability.

territories.title: Four landscapes, one North
territories.lead: From the granite of Gerês to the cliffs of the International Douro, Northern Portugal changes with every valley. Choose a territory on the map to discover it.
territories.mapLabel: Map of Northern Portugal with the four territories

geres.name: Peneda-Gerês
geres.tagline: Granite, water and the only national park
geres.text: Portugal's only national park and a Biosphere Reserve. Shepherds' trails, waterfalls, ancient oak woods and Barrosã cattle in the meadows, with stone houses that welcome only a few guests at a time.

douro.name: Douro Valley
douro.text: The oldest demarcated wine region in the world, a World Heritage landscape. We walk among hillside vineyards and family estates, with cellar tastings, lunches among the vines and the river always below.

tras.name: Trás-os-Montes
tras.tagline: The Portugal that still keeps time
tras.text: High plateaus, communal villages and the cliffs of the International Douro. A land of olive oil, chestnuts and smoked meats, of the Mirandese language and of traditions that are not staged here: they are everyday life.

santiago.name: Portuguese Interior Way
santiago.tagline: The route we manage, all the way to Santiago
santiago.text: From Viseu to Chaves, through Lamego, the Douro and Vila Real, to the border and on to Santiago de Compostela. A less travelled pilgrim way, among vineyards, spa towns and villages, with the comfort of having everything taken care of.

experiences.title: Experiences no catalogue holds
experiences.lead: Every programme joins the path to what the territory holds most its own: the table, the wine, the olive oil, the culture and the landscape.

mesa.title: At the region's table
mesa.text: Smoked meats, kid goat, Mirandese veal and wood-fired bread, served by the people who make them: in the village, at the quinta or at a picnic halfway along the path.

vinho.title: Quintas and cellars
vinho.text: Private tastings at Douro family estates, from old vines to vintage Port, with the winemaker or the owner of the house.

azeite.title: Olive groves and mills
azeite.text: The centuries-old olive groves of Trás-os-Montes and an olive oil tasting at the mill, from the olive to the table.

cultura.title: Living heritage
cultura.text: Manor houses, monasteries, granite and schist villages, the Caretos of Podence and the Mirandese language, told by those who keep them.

natureza.title: Protected landscapes
natureza.text: A national park, natural parks and a World Heritage landscape, walked unhurried and far from the crowds.

dayTours.lead: For programmes that need one extraordinary day within a longer stay. The same guides, the same access, the same table.

picnic.title: Picnics along the way
picnic.text: Tables set at viewpoints, among vines and by the river, with the best of what local producers make.

quintas.title: The finest quintas
quintas.text: Private access to family estates and to cellars closed to the public.

stays.title: Characterful stays
stays.text: Manor houses, wine estates and small hotels, chosen house by house.

guides.title: Native guides
guides.text: Certified guides, born in the region, who tell the territory because they lived it.

private.title: One group at a time
private.text: Private programmes, a pace made to measure and support on the ground throughout the journey.
